words.definition: n. 丑闻，丑事；流言飞语

examples.en: The bribery scandal forced the minister to resign.
examples.zh: 贿赂丑闻迫使部长辞职。

examples.en: She loves a bit of scandal at the office.
examples.zh: 她热衷于传播办公室八卦。

words.usage: cause/be involved in a scandal（引发/卷入丑闻）高频；political/sex scandal；scandalous adj. 丑闻的（scandalous behaviour）；scandalize 震惊。
collocations: cover up a scandal 掩盖丑闻

words.definition: v.（使）缠结，乱作一团 n. 乱团；纠纷

examples.en: The wool got tangled in the washing machine.
examples.zh: 毛线在洗衣机里缠成一团。

examples.en: He got into a tangle with the tax office.
examples.zh: 他与税务局陷入了纠纷。

words.usage: get tangled up in（卷入；缠住）高频；a tangled web（错综复杂的局面）；tang 与 tangled（纠结的）；hair tangles 头发打结。
collocations: get tangled up 缠住；卷入
a tangled web 一团乱麻

words.definition: n. 手段，策略；（复）战术

examples.en: The delay tactic failed to stop the vote.
examples.zh: 拖延战术未能阻止表决。

examples.en: They tried every tactic to win the deal.
examples.zh: 为赢得这笔交易他们用尽了手段。

words.usage: tactics（复）战术；a delay/dividend tactic（拖延/分红策略）；tactical adj. 战术的（tactical voting 战术投票）；tact（策略）词根同 tactful。

words.definition: n. 接受者，受领者

examples.en: She was the recipient of the 2020 peace prize.
examples.zh: 她是 2020 年和平奖得主。

examples.en: Email recipients can reply directly.
examples.zh: 邮件收件人可以直接回复。

words.usage: the recipient of（…的获得/接受者）高频；award/organ recipient（奖项/器官受者）；recipient country（受援国）；re（回）+ cip（拿）→ 接住者。

words.definition: v. 轻敲，轻拍；开发利用 n. 水龙头；轻叩

examples.en: Someone was tapping on the window.
examples.zh: 有人在轻敲窗户。

examples.en: The city tapped new sources of clean energy.
examples.zh: 这座城市开发了新的清洁能源。

words.usage: tap on the shoulder（轻拍肩膀）；tap into（开发利用；接入）高频；tap water（自来水）；tap resources（开发资源）；与 tape（磁带）形近。
collocations: tap on the shoulder 轻拍肩

words.definition: adj. 稀缺的，不足的 adv.（scarcely）几乎不

examples.en: Clean water is scarce in the region.
examples.zh: 该地区洁净水稀缺。

examples.en: Tickets were so scarce that they sold out in minutes.
examples.zh: 门票太紧俏，几分钟就售罄。

words.usage: become scarce（变得稀缺）高频；make oneself scarce（悄悄溜走）习语；scarcity n. 稀缺（water scarcity 水短缺）；scarcely adv. 几乎不。
collocations: make oneself scarce 避开不露面

words.definition: n. （报纸）社论，评论 adj. 编辑的

examples.en: The paper ran a hard-hitting editorial on corruption.
examples.zh: 该报刊发了一篇言辞犀利的反腐社论。

examples.en: She made an editorial decision to cut the chapter.
examples.zh: 她做出编辑决定删去这一章。

words.usage: write/run an editorial（撰写/刊发社论）高频；editorial board（编辑委员会）；edit v. → editor n. → editorial；重音在 -to-。
collocations: run an editorial 刊发社论

words.definition: n. 植被，植物（总称）

examples.en: Little vegetation survives in the desert.
examples.zh: 沙漠里几乎没有植被存活。

examples.en: Dense vegetation covered the riverbanks.
examples.zh: 茂密的植被覆盖着河岸。

words.usage: dense/lush vegetation（茂密植被）高频；veget（植物）同根 vegetable；不可数总称，与 plants（可数个体）之别。

words.definition: v. 处理，解决；（球赛）阻截 n. 用具；阻截

examples.en: The government promised to tackle inflation.
examples.zh: 政府承诺解决通胀问题。

examples.en: He was injured in a hard tackle.
examples.zh: 他在一次凶狠的铲球中受伤。

words.usage: tackle a problem/issue（解决问题）高频；fishing tackle（渔具）；tack（大头钉）+ le → 钉住问题 → 解决；与 tack（钉；策略）同根。
collocations: tackle a problem 解决问题
words.mnemonic: tack 钉住问题 → tackle 解决

words.definition: v. 后退，退去；（逐渐）减弱

examples.en: The flood waters finally began to recede.
examples.zh: 洪水终于开始退去。

examples.en: His hairline is receding.
examples.zh: 他的发际线在后退。

words.usage: recede from（从…退去）；receding gums/hairline（牙龈萎缩/发际线后移）；recession（衰退）同根；re（回）+ cede（走）。
collocations: recede into the distance 渐行渐远
flood waters recede 洪水退去
receding hairline 后退的发际线

words.definition: n. 调味酱，味汁；（口语）莽撞无礼

examples.en: Pour the tomato sauce over the pasta.
examples.zh: 把番茄酱浇在意面上。

examples.en: What a sauce! Talking to me like that!
examples.zh: 好大的胆子，竟这样跟我说话！

words.usage: soy/tomato sauce（酱油/番茄酱）高频；saucepan（深平底锅）派生；saucy adj.（无礼的；俏皮的）；与 source（来源）同音必辨！

words.definition: n. 油轮，罐车；加油机

examples.en: An oil tanker ran aground near the reef.
examples.zh: 一艘油轮在礁石附近搁浅。

examples.en: A fuel tanker crashed on the motorway.
examples.zh: 一辆油罐车在高速上撞毁。

words.usage: oil/fuel tanker（油轮/油罐车）新闻高频；tank（罐）+ er → 运罐之船/车；air tanker（空中加油机）军事义。

words.definition: v. 浸透， saturate（使）饱和；充斥

examples.en: The heavy rain saturated the fields.
examples.zh: 大雨浸透了田野。

examples.en: The market is saturated with cheap imports.
examples.zh: 市场上廉价进口货泛滥。

words.usage: be saturated with（浸满；充斥）高频；saturated fat（饱和脂肪）营养高频；sat（满）同根 satisfy、sated；saturation n. 饱和。
collocations: saturate the market 使市场饱和
be saturated with 浸满；充斥

words.definition: n. 收据，收条；收到

examples.en: Keep the receipt in case you need a refund.
examples.zh: 保存好收据以备退款。

examples.en: We acknowledge receipt of your letter.
examples.zh: 来函收悉。

words.usage: keep/ask for a receipt（留/要收据）高频；on receipt of（在收到…后）公文高频；p 不发音（同 debt）；receive 的名词族；recipe（食谱）形近。
collocations: keep the receipt 保留收据
on receipt of 一经收到
words.mnemonic: receipt 收据 p 不响

words.definition: adv. 几乎不，简直没有；刚刚…就

examples.en: There was scarcely any food left in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱里几乎没剩什么吃的。

examples.en: Scarcely had we arrived when it started to rain.
examples.zh: 我们刚到就开始下雨。

words.usage: 否定意味副词，句首倒装：scarcely had… when…（刚…就）高频；scarcely ever（难得）；比 barely、hardly 语气更正式。

words.definition: n. 关税；收费表，价目

examples.en: The government raised tariffs on imported steel.
examples.zh: 政府上调了进口钢铁关税。

examples.en: Phone tariffs vary from country to country.
examples.zh: 各国手机资费不同。

words.usage: impose/raise tariffs（征收/上调关税）新闻高频；tariff barriers（关税壁垒）；与 tax（国内税）、duty（海关税）辨析；trade war 题材高频。

words.definition: n. 设想，方案；情节梗概

examples.en: In the worst-case scenario, we lose everything.
examples.zh: 最坏的情况下，我们会一无所有。

examples.en: The film imagines a post-apocalyptic scenario.
examples.zh: 影片设想了一个末日后场景。

words.usage: worst-case/best-case scenario（最坏/最好情形）高频；scenario planning（情景规划）商科；意大利语 scenery 词源；复数 scenarios。
words.mnemonic: scenario 剧本场景 → 设想

words.definition: adj. 互惠的，相互的

examples.en: The two universities have a reciprocal exchange agreement.
examples.zh: 两所大学签有互惠交换协议。

examples.en: Friendship should be reciprocal.
examples.zh: 友谊应当是相互的。

words.usage: reciprocal agreement/respect（互惠协议/相互尊重）高频；reciprocate v. 回报；reciprocity n. 互惠；re（回）+ pro（向前）→ 你来我往。

confusables.note: republic 共和国，re- 同头形近

collocations: on a reciprocal basis 以互惠为基础
words.mnemonic: recipro 你来我往 → 互惠

words.definition: n. 裁缝 v. 量身定制，调整以适应

examples.en: The suit was cut by a master tailor.
examples.zh: 这套西装出自裁缝大师之手。

examples.en: We tailor our courses to individual needs.
examples.zh: 我们按个人需求定制课程。

words.usage: tailor sth to/for（为…量身定制）高频；tailor-made（定制的）高频形容词；tail（剪裁）+ or；与 sailor（水手）、taylor 拼写错 区分。

words.definition: adj. 驯服的，温顺的；平淡的 v. 驯化；制服

examples.en: The deer in the park are so tame that they eat from your hand.
examples.zh: 公园里的鹿温顺得能从你手里吃东西。

examples.en: The film version tamed the novel's darker themes.
examples.zh: 电影版弱化了小说的黑暗主题。

words.usage: tame animal（驯养动物）对照 wild；a tame ending（平淡结局）贬义；tame inflation（抑制通胀）比喻义；tamely adv.。
collocations: a tame ending 平淡的结局
